Every hostile form independent security review demonstrated - uppercase and mixed-case scheme, protocol-relative authority, ftp:, data:, file:, javascript: and bare traversal - is rejected on BOTH input_ref and result_ref, and so are the four forms that defeat a scheme allow-list with a free body.
A well-formed private reference is still accepted on both fields, so the guard is not vacuously strict.

The two reference fields use the CTR-IDM-001 pattern verbatim and carry no deny-list, and both patterns are identical to each other so the two fields cannot drift apart. (2026-10-05: the two fields also must not admit a WHATWG special scheme. The standing guard asserts it as a property, C0 F4 / C3.)

The amendment is content-neutral as a MEASURED structural property: the parsed schema before and after differs only at the two reference constraints and the x-amended-by annotation, with zero leaf paths modified in place, no property added or removed, an unchanged required list, an unchanged tenant_context $ref, version 1.0.0 and freeze level Candidate.
The WP-0A-CON-002 x-amended-by record is carried forward deep-equal, not overwritten.

compatibility_impact: No contract changes. This increment touches no contract-catalog file, schema or fixture. It corrects RFC-2026-006's record (Decision 2's printed pattern, the Decision 4 tally, the scope-exclusion clause and Limitations) without changing its decision. It adds one assertion inside an existing test of the standing guard, which only narrows what CI accepts. It updates this package's manifest for the role verdicts' conditions and the Owner's step-2 decisions, and moves two digests in test-kits/integrity-manifest.json.
known_limitations: The CTR-JOB-001 Integration Owner acknowledgement of this cross-package amendment is PENDING. Since 2026-10-05 it is owed by /claude/r0_steward, whom the Product Owner named successor to /root/r0_steward (step 2 item 2, evidence/WP-0A-A0-001/product-owner-disposition-2026-10-05-g0-step2.md). Both x-amended-by records on ctr-job-001/schema.json still name /root/r0_steward in acknowledgement_required_from and read acknowledgement_status: pending. That file is outside this package's writable paths, so the successor records the acknowledgement there and it is not countersigned here.

No script or CI job in this repository reads acknowledgement_status. The standing guard reads it, but only asserts that it is one of pending/acknowledged. C0 flipped both records to acknowledged on a disposable copy and the guard passed, so self-countersigning goes undetected. The only control is human review of the diff. Carried forward unresolved from the WP-0A-CON-002 contract review (N-C1). Owner of the gap: whoever owns scripts/ and CI (Integration Owner path), not this package.

This amendment is heavier than RFC-2026-004's. That RFC corrected $refs that were BROKEN and could not have been depended on. This one tightens a constraint that ACCEPTS values today, so it is a narrowing of accepted input, not a repair of a dangling pointer. Nothing in the repository depends on the old breadth - CTR-JOB-001 has no implementation and its only instances are its own two fixtures - but the class of change differs and the Integration Owner should dispose of it on that basis. (2026-10-05: the Product Owner's disposition of RFC-2026-006 is on record, 2026-09-02, commit 82aae60. The Integration Owner's disposition of the class of change is still owed, now by /claude/r0_steward.)
Two WP-0A-CON-001 fixtures had to change because the shipped valid.json did NOT satisfy the tightened schema. The contract's own reference example was written in a form its stated intent excludes.

A third WP-0A-CON-001 file, test-kits/contracts/shared-kernel-contract-catalog.test.mjs, had to change because its assertions made the defect mandatory and its acceptance predicate carried the same bypasses. Amending another package's test is a wider surface than RFC-2026-004 needed.

A sixth cross-package file, test-kits/integrity-manifest.json, belongs to WP-0A-A0-002 and had to change because the coverage-floor guard refuses an undigested test file (exit 87) or a digested file whose bytes moved (exit 86). Its acknowledgement runs to /claude/r0_steward and is likewise not countersigned here. WP-0A-A0-002 is in_review, so this package amends a file whose own package has not yet been integrated. (2026-10-05: WP-0A-A0-002 is still in_review at main 600b48b, and this increment updates one digest in the same file; see authorized_cross_package_amendments[6].)

The scheme allow-list job|status|result|app|asset|content is adopted from CTR-IDM-001 for catalog consistency, NOT decided here. Whether that closed set is right for a job envelope is a contract-owner decision open before freeze. (2026-10-05: the standing guard now rejects every WHATWG special scheme, so widening the set to a network-dereferenceable scheme fails CI. Whether the set is right is still undecided.)

A constrained reference string is not an authorization decision. A reference of the correct shape naming ANOTHER TENANT's object still passes: the envelope carries no binding between tenant_context.workspace_id and the reference body. That binding is not invented here and remains open before freeze.
The negative fixture on disk demonstrates ONE hostile form. The other fifteen are covered only by the standing guard, not by a fixture.

This package depends on WP-0A-A0-002 and WP-0A-CON-002. Both are still in_review at main 600b48b, yet the work of both is present in main. The status fields and the tree disagree (C0 blocker triage 13, A1 §7 row 13). This package inherits every open blocker recorded on them. Integration Owner attention, not an Author fix.
Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; this package is restricted to reversible, synthetic-only work.

CTR-JOB-001 job_type, lease_owner, progress_stage and last_error_code carry no maxLength and no pattern. Each accepts 100,000 characters, a credential-shaped body, an email address, a phone number or a page of user content (A1 S3, Medium). max_attempts, timeout_seconds, attempt and job_version have no upper bound, and priority is unbounded in both directions, so retry-storm and queue-starvation shapes conform (A1 S8, Low). DISCLOSURE ONLY, NOT CLOSURE: bounding these fields is a contract decision outside this package's scope. It is escalated to the CTR-JOB-001 owner as a required_before_freeze item, exactly as WP-0A-CON-002 escalated the reference defect to this package.

A conforming reference can carry up to 248 opaque body characters (maxLength 256 less the scheme), and those can be credential-shaped or PII-shaped. x-reference-rule states the rejections at length and does not state this residual (A1 S5, Medium). The constraint is a shape rule, not a content rule. Escalated to the CTR-JOB-001 owner with the item above.

Owed to other owners and not closeable from this package's writable paths: (a) an x-amended-by record on ctr-api-001/schema.json and ctr-idm-001/schema.json for the 64d9c65 lookahead removal, owed by WP-0A-CON-001's owner, acknowledged by /claude/r0_steward (A1 C1); (b) CTR-NTF-001 deep_link.target_ref is unbounded, because the bound ratchet in ctr-evt-001-schema-ref-bounds.test.mjs enumerates four contracts instead of discovering them (C0 F5), owed by CTR-NTF-001's owner; (c) the hand-written REFERENCE_PATTERN and isPrivateRef predicates still carry the lookahead form, which is equivalent but diverges in text (C0 F6), owed by WP-0A-CON-001 and WP-0A-CON-002; (d) CTR-JOB-001 dedupe_key composition and the absent x-source, a required_before_freeze item for CTR-JOB-001's owner (C0 §5).
